component.name: Prismatic
component.summary: Emulate SGI workstations with the Happy Years interface

description.p: Prismatic is a Rust and SDL3 desktop interface for our fork of Iris. Configure SGI Indy, Indigo2, O2 and Octane machines, attach disk and CD images, and boot supported guest operating systems including IRIX and NetBSD.
Save named machine configurations, manage media and networking, and capture screenshots and animated GIFs using the Happy Years overlay menus.
